question: 按证券类型统计 2013 年成交量，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT ds.Issue AS issue, SUM(ft.Quantity) AS total_trade_quantity FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_security ds ON ft.SK_SecurityID = ds.SK_SecurityID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2013 GROUP BY ds.Issue ORDER BY total_trade_quantity DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: Issue 区分股票（COMMON/PREF）等证券子类，属金融工具
成交量是证券交易数量的合计
